_comment: Composable impact presets on top of the edit kit (dom-edit-helpers.js): each preset is a list of existing kit calls, so no new FX API exists. {t} is the event time in seconds (frame-aligned by the planner), F is one frame. `flashes` counts full-frame luminance changes for the photosensitivity check (no more than 3 a second). `reduced` names the preset used under --reduced-flash. Impact frames are 1-4 FRAMES; a 1-2 second burst strobes.

impact-1f.what: one inverted frame at contact; the lightest readable hit

impact-2f.what: two inverted frames at contact, the FRONTIER default

hit-full.what: impact frames + flash + heavy shake (the kit's hit())

hit-soft.what: flash at low peak + shake, no inversion
calls: shake({t}, 0.35, 12, {{ decay: 3, seed: {seed}, cover: true, snap: true }})

shake-only.what: camera shake alone; safe for photosensitive review
calls: shake({t}, 0.35, 12, {{ decay: 3, seed: {seed}, cover: true, snap: true }})

silhouette-flash.what: near-black tint for 3 frames: figures read as silhouettes against the flash

blackout-2f.what: graphic cut: two black frames hide a contact the footage cannot show

whip-into-cut.what: horizontal whip blur carrying motion across the cut (smear / speed emphasis)
